panel.title: 🛸 ShadowPilot — control panel
panel.hint_no_connection: Connect the bot: Telegram Settings → Telegram Business → Chatbots.
panel.hint_test: 💡 Send me any text here to preview how the AI answers.
panel.mode_help: Always — always reply, default reason. By schedule — always reply, reason from the matching slot. Only in slots — reply only inside schedule slots.
panel.rules_title: 🕐 Schedule Times are in {timezone}. A night slot (21:30–07:00) belongs to the day it starts on.
panel.days_title: 📆 Days for slot #{index} {start}–{end} Now: {days} Tap days to toggle them.
panel.exceptions_title: 🏖 Exceptions (replace the weekly slots on these dates)
panel.ai_schedule_hint: 🪄 Just write what to change — the AI builds a new schedule and asks you to confirm. e.g. «delete everything, only sleep every day 21:30-7:00», «school Mon–Fri 8:00-15:00», «winter holidays 22.12–6.01, no school»
panel.ai_schedule_failed: ⚠️ The AI could not build a valid schedule: {error} Try to rephrase.
panel.ai_schedule_disabled: ⚠️ AI is disabled, the AI schedule editor is not available.
panel.proposal_refine: Or send another message to adjust the proposal.
panel.ask_add_rule: ➕ New slot Send time and reason in one message: 23:00-07:00 Sleeping right now 🌙 Or just a time range — then pick a preset reason: 08:00-15:00
panel.ask_rule_time: 🕐 Send a new time range, e.g. 09:00-18:00
panel.ask_rule_text: 💬 Send the new reason text for this slot (or tap a preset).
panel.ask_default_reason: 💬 Default reason Current: {value} Send a new text or tap a preset. Used when no slot matches.
panel.bad_time: ⚠️ Could not read the time. Use HH:MM-HH:MM, e.g. 23:00-07:00.
panel.too_long: ⚠️ Too long — keep it under {max} characters.
panel.confirm_clear: 🧹 Delete everything: the archive of all chats, AI memory and topics? This cannot be undone.
panel.chats_title: 👥 Chats Send a @username or Telegram ID to open a chat, or pick a recent one below.
panel.chats_empty: No chats yet — they appear after the first incoming business message.
panel.chat_not_found: 🔍 Nothing found for {query}. The person must have written to you at least once since the bot was connected.
panel.chat_title: 👤 {title} 🆔 {chatId} 💾 Archived messages: {count} (AI sees the last {limit}) 📝 Your context for the AI: {context} 🤖 AI memory (written by the AI itself): {aiMemory}
panel.chat_no_context: empty — add notes the AI should know: who this person is, inside jokes, how to talk to them…
panel.ask_set_context: ✏️ Send the new context for {title}. It replaces the current one. Example: This is my classmate Dima. "Banana" is our inside joke about the physics teacher, just laugh along.
panel.ask_append_context: ➕ Send text to add to the context of {title}.
panel.confirm_clear_chat: 🧹 Delete the whole archive of the chat with {title}, its AI memory and topics?
panel.memory_help: 🗑 / ✏️ — when someone deletes or edits a message, I send you the original (text and media). 📚 The whole chat is always stored; only the last N messages are sent to the AI as context. 🤖 AI memory — the AI keeps short notes about every chat (who it is, projects, agreements), so older messages are not forgotten. When turned on, existing chats are analyzed from the database. 🗂 Topics — conversations are split into topics with a summary, message count and time range. A chat is analyzed after it has been quiet for a while.
panel.dialogs_empty: No topics yet — a chat is analyzed after it has been quiet for a while.
panel.dialogs_disabled: Topics are off. Turn them on in 🧠 Memory & tracking.
panel.chat_reanalyzing: 🔄 re-reading the whole chat… I'll message you when it's done.
panel.confirm_reanalyze: 🔄 Forget the AI memory and topics of {title} and rebuild them from the whole chat ({count} messages)? With a local model this can take a while. Your own context is not touched.
panel.reanalyze_done: ✅ {title}: AI memory rewritten from {count} messages, topics: {topics}.
panel.premium_status_yes: 🟢 Your account has Telegram Premium — the pairs below are used in AI replies.
panel.premium_status_no: ⚪️ Telegram Premium not detected on the connected account — regular emoji are used. (checked once a day)
panel.premium_help: How to add: send a regular emoji followed by the premium emoji that should replace it, one pair per line: 🤖 [premium emoji] 📌 [premium emoji] Send only the regular emoji on a line to remove its pair. Replacements apply to the header and to the AI's text.
panel.premium_bad_input: ⚠️ No pairs found. Send a regular emoji and then a premium emoji on the same line.
panel.rich_help: 📰 Rich messages: headings, lists, quotes, tables and code from the AI are shown with real formatting. 🧩 The panel and notifications use them too. If Telegram refuses rich messages for an account (e.g. without Premium), its replies fall back to normal formatting and rich is retried an hour later. ✍️ Drafts (test chat with the bot): the reply appears with Telegram's typing animation instead of message edits. ✨ Premium emoji need Telegram Premium on the connected account.
panel.prompt_help: Placeholders: {ownerName}, {reason}, {time}. The chat history (with authors), your per-chat context and the AI memory are added automatically.
panel.prompt_truncated: …(shortened here, the full text is used)
panel.ask_prompt: ✏️ Send the new system prompt as one message. It replaces the current one. Tip: tap the text above to copy it, edit it and send it back.
panel.confirm_prompt_reset: 🔄 Restore the default system prompt from config.js?
panel.prompt_too_short: ⚠️ Too short for a system prompt — send the full instruction.
panel.ask_owner_name: 👤 Your name Current: {value} Send the name the AI should use (in the header and in replies).
panel.members_help:
👑 admin · ✅ approved · ⏳ waiting · ⛔️ declined
Every account has its own settings, chats and memory. Tap one to approve, revoke or manage it.
panel.confirm_member_delete: 🗑 Remove {name}? Their settings, chats, archive, AI memory and topics are deleted. If they keep the bot connected, a new access request will appear.
panel.ai_mode_title: ⏸ AI in the chat with {title} {status} 🔇 Only auto-replies off — the bot does not answer here; archive, deleted/edited tracking, AI memory and topics keep working. 🚫 AI completely off — no answers, and the AI never sees messages from this period (not in replies, memory or topics, even later). They are still archived for deleted/edited tracking. Pick a duration (∞ = until you turn it back on):
panel.ai_mode_status_replies_off: 🤖 AI in this chat: 🔇 auto-replies off {until}

tracking.deleted_unknown: +{count} more not in the archive (sent before the bot was connected)

access.pending: ⏳ Your request is waiting for approval. You will get a message as soon as an admin decides.
access.waiting: 👋 Thanks for connecting ShadowPilot! ⏳ Your request was sent to the admin. Until it is approved the bot does not answer or store anything in your chats.
access.approved: ✅ Access approved! Send /panel to set up your schedule, name and AI settings. The bot answers in your chats according to them.
access.rejected: ⛔️ Your request was declined. The bot will not answer in your chats.
access.revoked: ⛔️ Your access was revoked. The bot no longer answers in your chats.
